desc: Modeled after an early frontier pattern, the Cold Steel Trail Hawk has proven to be incredibly popular with Survivalists, Preppers and Outdoorsmen, who admire its versatility and durability. Its an excellent chopping tool and has a functional hammer poll with a hardened face so you can drive nails and hammer in stakes. Its extremely lightweight and a cinch to tuck it under your belt or lash it to a pack or shooting bag.
